versions.changelog:
token-efficient-task-router v0.6.8

- Clarified the skill's purpose and scope as an ROI- and safety-focused task router and token controller for various agent systems.
- Added detailed classification rules across clarity, complexity, risk, and token cost for routing user requests.
- Defined usage scenarios, including when not to use the skill to avoid over-processing simple tasks.
- Provided explicit focus activation, calibration, progressive delivery, and chat confirmation rules.
- Expanded core principles to emphasize staged execution, smallest-useful-mode, and confirmation gates.
- Included Chinese-language core guideline for multilingual support.
